leads_list_unworked: unworked for more than a week
leads_list_empty_body: A lead is somebody who might buy, before you know enough to call it a deal. Import a list, or add the last person who emailed you.
leads_board_move_failed: Could not move the lead, so it went back.
leads_board_empty_body: A pipeline sorts {plural} into stages you move them through. An admin can create one under lead pipelines in settings, or by applying an industry pack.
leads_board_no_stages: This pipeline has no stages yet, so there is nowhere to move a lead.
leads_board_hint: Drag a card, or use "Move to" on it, to change its stage. A lead in no stage joins this pipeline when you move it into one, and leaves it when you move it back to No stage.
leads_board_not_movable: That lead is not one you can move.
leads_field_value_hint: What the deal would be worth if it lands.
leads_error_name: A lead needs a name to be findable. First or last will do.
leads_error_email_invalid: That does not look like an email address.
leads_error_phone_format: 7 to 25 characters: digits, spaces, brackets, dots, dashes. No extensions.
leads_error_amount_nan: Estimated value has to be a number.
leads_new_sub: A name and a company is enough to start. The rest can wait.
leads_new_status_hint: Converting is a significant, largely irreversible step: it creates an Account, a Contact and an Opportunity that nothing undoes if the status changes back, and it requires an email address that nothing else here does. Set the status here to something else, and convert once the lead is real.
leads_detail_cannot_reach_text: No email and no phone on this lead, so there is no way to contact {name}. Add one before you can work it.
leads_detail_needs_owner_worth: Worth {amount} and nobody owns it. Assign an owner before it goes cold.
leads_detail_needs_owner_text: Nobody owns this lead. Assign an owner so it does not sit unworked.
leads_detail_never_contacted_text: Created {when} and still never contacted. Reach out, or recycle it.
leads_detail_delete_explain: Deletes {name} permanently. This cannot be undone.
leads_detail_converted_body_deals: The account, contact and deal this lead became carry the work now. Converting again would build a second deal against the same account, and the API refuses it.
leads_detail_converted_body: The account and contact this lead became carry the work now.
leads_detail_convert_explain_deals_worth: Creates an *account*, a *contact* and one *deal* worth {amount}. The lead stays linked, and there is no endpoint that undoes it.
leads_detail_convert_explain_deals: Creates an *account*, a *contact* and one *deal*. The lead stays linked, and there is no endpoint that undoes it.
leads_detail_convert_explain: Creates an *account* and a *contact*. The lead stays linked, and there is no endpoint that undoes it.
leads_detail_convert_title_deals: Creates an account, a contact and an opportunity from this lead
leads_detail_convert_title: Creates an account and a contact from this lead
leads_detail_convert_needs_email_title: Add an email address to this lead first. The contact record is created from it.
leads_detail_convert_needs_email: Add an email address first. The contact record is created from it.
leads_detail_converted_ready_deals: The account, contact and deal are ready.
leads_detail_converted_ready: The account and contact are ready.
leads_detail_note_placeholder: Log a call, a reply, what they said…
leads_note_needs_text_with_file: Add a note to save alongside the file.
leads_note_needs_text: Write something before you save the note.
leads_not_found: That lead does not exist, or you do not have access to it.
leads_edit_converted_body: Every edit on this form was saved to the lead first, and the lead was then converted from it. Open what the conversion made below.
leads_edit_saved_body: Changes to “{name}” are on the record.
leads_edit_email_required: Converting creates a Contact, and a contact without an email cannot be reached.
leads_edit_email_taken: Another lead in this org already uses that address.
leads_edit_email_hint: One lead per address per org, ignoring case. The database enforces it, so a duplicate comes back as a rejected save rather than a second record.
leads_edit_phone_too_long: Phone is stored in 25 characters; this is {count}.
leads_edit_phone_invalid: Digits and separators only. The API rejects letters, so "x123" extensions have to go in the notes.
leads_edit_converted_title: This lead has already been converted
leads_edit_converted_p1: Its account, contact and opportunity exist and carry the work now. The status stays where it is: reopening the lead would not remove any of them, and converting it again would build a second opportunity against the same account. The API refuses both.
leads_edit_converted_p2: Everything else on this form is still editable. A converted lead is a record, not a read-only one.
leads_edit_entering_p1: An Account, a Contact and an Opportunity, with this lead's comments and attachments moved across. The lead stays as a converted record, and this is the last time you can change its status. There is no endpoint that undoes any of it.
leads_edit_entering_p2: Any other change on this form, aside from custom fields, is dropped when it saves alongside a conversion. Reopen the lead afterwards to redo it.
